run_segment_pr: run segment_pr to compute segment precision and recall for video alignment queries
run_map: run map to compute mean average precision for video retrieval on EVVE or localization datasets
run_map_evve: run map_evve to compute mAP on EVVE dataset with optional query expansion and temporal consistency
run_map_localization: run map_localization to compute mAP for temporal video localization across all query-video pairs
run_localization_errors: run localization_errors to compute temporal offset errors and report percentage within thresholds
